name: 5D Claw Security
description: Deterministic per-action policy gate. Scores every tool call on five dimensions (Data, Tool, Reversibility, External, Autonomy), bands GREEN/YELLOW/ORANGE/RED, blocks RED, requests approval on ORANGE, passes GREEN/YELLOW. Bridges to the fivedrisk Python core via persistent stdio.

policyPath.description: Absolute path to the fivedrisk policy.yaml file. The skill installer writes one to ~/.fivedrisk/policy.yaml by default; supply a different path here to override.

pythonBin.description: Python interpreter used to run `python -m fivedrisk.gateway stdio`. Defaults to `python3` on PATH. Set to the absolute path of the venv interpreter when fivedrisk is installed inside a venv.

scoringTimeoutMs.description: Per-call timeout (milliseconds) for a single scoring round-trip to the Python core. On timeout the subprocess is killed, restarted, and the call is retried once. If both attempts time out, `onError` decides the outcome. Note: this is the scoring round-trip timeout, not the human-approval timeout. Human-approval timeout is OpenClaw-native (configured in the gateway's `tools.exec.approvals.*` settings), out of plugin scope.

onError.description: What to do when the Python core is unreachable after a restart and one retry. `block` fails closed (recommended; matches the security-tool default). `allow` fails open (pass-through, no scoring). Throws from the hook handler become pass-through in OpenClaw, so `block` must be explicit.

uiHints.summary: Score every tool call on 5 dimensions, block RED, request approval on ORANGE.
